title: Do not spend the passing day in gossip
summary: A passing life is squandered when the tongue feeds on gossip. Return the mouth to praise before it carries hurt.
takeaway: Return the mouth to praise before it carries hurt.
lifeApplication: Before the next message leaves your mouth, pause with one breath and choose the sentence that can still be honored tonight.

source.shortMeaning: A passing life is squandered when the tongue feeds on gossip.
source.lifeApplication: When gossip feels easy, remember how quickly the body passes.
